title: Specification Engineering Schema Check
description: Deterministic checks for specification-engineering payloads (section coverage, spec body, traceability matrix, path bans).

checks.rule: every entry has unknowns[] with at least one UNKNOWN:… or UNKNOWN: none noted
source_paths must not contain 'ai-os/architecture' or start with 'docs/architecture/' (use artifacts/product-architecture/ or artifacts/architecture-v2/)
when type=project-specification and status=ready: entries must include all 13 required section kinds (project-overview…testing-strategy) or explicit gap entries naming missing kinds

when type=project-specification and entry_kind not in {conflict,gap}: purpose,scope,actors,preconditions,postconditions,workflow,business_rules,validation_rules,error_handling,edge_cases,dependencies,acceptance_criteria required (UNKNOWN:… allowed)
when type=project-specification and entry_kind not in {conflict,gap}: traceability must include feature,business_rule,api,database,workflow,architecture_decision,source_artifact (UNKNOWN:… allowed)
when type=engineering-task-graph and status=ready: include ≥1 epic, ≥1 feature|story, ≥1 task|subtask, and dependency|depends_on edges as needed
when type=delivery-roadmap and status=ready: include ≥1 phase|release, ≥1 delivery-order, ≥1 risk
when type=implementation-plan and status=ready: include ≥1 build-order, ≥1 critical-path, and ≥1 parallel-work|blocked

roadmap must not invent work-item depends_on that contradict artifacts/tasks/; implementation build-order must cite artifacts/tasks/ + artifacts/roadmap/; see core/packages/pipelines/specification-engineering/RACI.md
